events.headline: Peak valuation $3.44Bn (Series H)
events.description: Unacademy raised $440M Series H led by Temasek at $3.44Bn valuation; total $880M across 13 rounds

events.headline: Laid off 250 employees
events.description: Unacademy laid off 250 employees; no appraisals for 2024 employees

events.headline: Hemesh Singh leaves Unacademy
events.description: Co-founder & CTO Hemesh Singh left the startup; moved to advisory role

events.headline: Allen Career Institute acquisition talks at $800M
events.description: Extended discussions with Allen Career Institute for potential sale valuing Unacademy at $800M; talks failed over valuation differences

events.headline: K12 Techno/Orchids merger talks
events.description: Unacademy in early talks to merge with K12 Techno (Orchids International Schools); did not materialise

events.headline: Gaurav Munjal and Roman Saini exit announced
events.description: Cofounders Munjal and Saini set to exit; Munjal stepping down as CEO; Sumit Jain to take over; focus shifting to Airlearn

events.headline: Sumit Jain appointed CEO of Test Prep business
events.description: Sumit Jain appointed chief executive of test-prep business; Munjal handed reins to Jain

events.headline: upGrad-Unacademy merger talks collapse
events.description: upGrad-Unacademy merger collapsed due to valuation gap; Unacademy announced pivot to franchise model for offline centres

events.headline: Unacademy to shut company-operated offline centres
events.description: Unacademy announced exit from company-operated offline centres; transition to franchise model by April 2026

events.headline: upGrad internal round Rs 360 Cr
events.description: upGrad raised Rs 360 Cr internal round (Screwvala Rs 300 Cr, Temasek, IFC, 360 One) ahead of Unacademy acquisition

events.headline: CCI approves upGrad-Unacademy merger
events.description: Competition Commission of India approved upGrad's acquisition of Sorting Hat Technologies (Unacademy parent)

events.headline: upGrad completes Unacademy acquisition for ~$206M
events.description: All-stock deal completed; Munjal confirmed 'We raised at a peak, but sold at a fraction'; Unacademy brand retained; no layoffs planned

events.headline: Sumit Jain resigns ahead of upGrad deal
events.description: Sumit Jain stepped away from operational role; exit effective Jun 30, 2026; Munjal to return to lead
